t: The Human as a Tool Call: A Case Study in Hybrid AI-Assisted Refactoring
s: This case study details the refactoring of a monolithic Python plugin within the Pipulate framework using a hybrid AI-human approach. It emphasizes human expertise for precise code transplantation where AI falters, showcasing a symbiotic development model.
sub: Manual Code Transplantation with Editor Skills
Leveraging AI for Planning, Human for Precision
